records.name: policy-successor-same-version
records.rule: new configuration is a new version

records.name: publication-published-policy-context
records.rule: a record without project_id checked against its policy

records.name: publication-published-with-reason
records.rule: reason only when blocked or failed

records.name: publication-execution-not-root
records.rule: execution_id is the root's own ID

records.name: run-manifest-policy-context
records.rule: run manifest checked against its policy

records.name: run-manifest-withheld-gap
records.rule: withheld paths count from 1 without gaps

records.name: run-manifest-public-uri-other-base
records.rule: public_uri is the policy's base URI plus the key

records.name: omissions-duplicate-redaction
records.rule: one declaration per path and category

records.name: endpoint-path-dot-dot
records.rule: endpoint path has no dot segments

records.name: mutation-identity-mode-only
records.rule: a mode change is a change

records.name: mutation-identity-both-null
records.rule: a change has at least one side

records.name: operation-identity-call
records.rule: operation identity of a provider call

records.name: expected-trials-observe-root
records.rule: observe expected trials for a root request

records.name: job-request-admission-in-context
records.rule: request inherits its policy and root

records.name: job-request-root-with-parent
records.rule: a root request has no parent

records.name: job-request-child-without-parent
records.rule: a child request has a parent

records.name: job-request-own-parent
records.rule: a request is never its own parent

records.name: job-request-wrong-operation-id
records.rule: operation id computed from the request

records.name: job-request-call-operation-id
records.rule: a job's operation id has a null call name

records.name: job-request-wrong-payload-hash
records.rule: payload hash computed from the request

records.name: job-request-url-trials-key
records.rule: expected trials key is an artifact key

records.name: expected-trials-admission-no-original-suite
records.rule: only observe runs without the original suite

records.name: expected-trials-admission-reordered
records.rule: trial list order matches the kind

records.name: expected-trials-kit-wrong-state
records.rule: code state follows the trial id

records.name: expected-trials-judge-as-admission
records.rule: trial list matches the request kind

records.name: job-request-for-expected-trials-hash-mismatch
records.rule: request whose hash differs from the manifest

records.name: expected-trials-duplicate-check
records.rule: check ids unique in a trial

records.name: expected-trials-null-suite-with-tests
records.rule: null original suite has no tests

records.name: expected-trials-pass-with-code
records.rule: a pass has no failure code

records.name: expected-trials-fail-without-code
records.rule: an assertion failure has a code

records.name: expected-trials-fail-with-reason
records.rule: an expected failure is an assertion failure code

records.name: check-observation-fail-with-reason
records.rule: an assertion failure has an assertion code

records.name: check-observation-fail-without-code
records.rule: an assertion failure has a code

records.name: check-observation-with-version
records.rule: an observation has no schema version

records.name: trial-observations-sorted
records.rule: sorted by repeat, then check id

records.name: trial-observations-check-unsorted
records.rule: check ids sorted within a repeat

records.name: trial-result-invalid
records.rule: invalid trial result with both pairs

records.name: trial-result-incomplete
records.rule: incomplete trial result with null pairs

records.name: trial-result-complete-null-pairs
records.rule: a complete result has both pairs

records.name: trial-result-invalid-null-pairs
records.rule: an invalid result has both pairs

records.name: trial-result-complete-with-reason
records.rule: a complete result has no reason

records.name: trial-result-incomplete-no-reason
records.rule: an incomplete result has a reason

records.name: observed-symptom-event-extra-field
records.rule: no other field in an event

records.name: observed-symptom-request-extra-field
records.rule: no other field in the request

records.name: observed-symptom-example-extra-field
records.rule: no other field in an example

records.name: observed-symptom-bucket-extra-field
records.rule: no other field in a bucket

records.name: observed-symptom-excerpt-extra-field
records.rule: no other field in an excerpt

records.name: observed-symptom-query-name
records.rule: query names are public parameter names
